components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          items:

        - type

## Summary

I implemented telephone normalization on owner creation for this Spring Boot PetClinic REST app.

The challenge: the create flow validates the incoming `OwnerFieldsDto` via Bean Validation (generated from `openapi.yml`), which had `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'` on `telephone`. That would reject an input like `(04) 1234-5678` with a 400 *before* any normalization could run — failing the accept test. So the fix spans three coordinated changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Relaxed the `telephone` field: removed the digit-only `pattern` (kept `minLength: 1`/`maxLength: 20`) so raw, punctuated numbers reach the controller, and documented the normalization contract in the description.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — After mapping the DTO, normalize the telephone via a new `normalizeTelephone` helper: strip every non-digit (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), require exactly 10 digits, and store/return that value. Applied only on create, matching the spec ("On create").

3. **New `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` + handler in `ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — Mirrors the existing `MissingOwnerFieldsException` pattern to reject a malformed telephone with a **400 Bad Request** (`errors: ["telephone"]`). A plain `ResponseStatusException` wouldn't have worked here because the advice's catch-all `@ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)` maps everything to 500.

The `Owner` entity's existing `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")`/`@Digits` constraints are left intact — the normalized 10-digit value satisfies them, so they still guard the persisted invariant.

Behavior now: `(04) 1234-5678` → stored/returned as `0412345678`; `12345` → 400.
